title: Edo kimekomi doll
summary: Carve a doll from a paulownia core, tuck patterned cloth into its grooves, wrap the gold sash and paint the face.
howToPlay: Match the doll in the frame.
Drag across each row to set its width.
Tap the bands to paint the cloth.
Press Paint face and tap each mark.
rules: The body is a wide hem, a narrow sash, sloping shoulders and a round head.
Cloth is pressed into carved grooves; the dark lines between the panels are the grooves.
Shape counts for 55 of the 100 points: how closely each row of the doll matches the lit outline.
The bands count for 25 points: each band must be the right colour.
The finishing touches count for 20 points: tap every glowing mark to paint the face.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40. Watch and learn paints a whole doll for you.
heritageNote: Kimekomi means 'tucked in': a carved wooden or paulownia-paste body is cut with fine grooves and scraps of silk are pressed into them with a thin blade, with no stitching.
